Maratha quota activist refuses water, medical aid on 8th day of fast

Manoj Jarange Patil, an activist seeking reservation for the Maratha community, has refused water and medical assistance as his hunger strike entered its eighth day. Patil is advocating for Maratha reservation in government jobs and education. His refusal of aid signifies an escalation in his protest. The specific demands relate to the inclusion of the Maratha community within the reservation framework.
